notes: Label vocabulary for in-cabin pilot clips (docs/research/INCABIN_PILOT_PROTOCOL.md). Times are seconds from the clip's first frame. Definitions are binding for annotators; change them only by bumping the version.

events.phone_use: Phone in the subject's hand AND the subject's eyes on the phone, sustained >= 1 s. Start: first frame both hold. End: first frame either stops.
events.phone_handling: Phone in hand without eyes on it (picking up, holding at the ear on a call, putting down).
events.eyes_off_road: Gaze outside the windscreen road region for >= 2 s continuously (cluster, infotainment, lap, passenger, phone). Mirror checks are NOT this.
events.glance_mirror_left: Gaze on the left mirror, 0.3-2 s. Legitimate; must not alert.
events.glance_mirror_right: Gaze on the right mirror, 0.3-2 s. Legitimate; must not alert.
events.glance_mirror_rear: Gaze on the rear-view mirror, 0.3-2 s. Legitimate; must not alert.
events.glance_cluster: Gaze on the instrument cluster, < 2 s. Legitimate; must not alert.
events.glance_infotainment: Gaze on the centre screen, < 2 s.
events.yawn: Mouth open in a yawn, with or without a hand.
events.nod: Head pitch drops and recovers (acted microsleep nod).
events.eating_drinking: Food or drink at the mouth.

states.eyes_closed: Both upper lids cover the pupils. Per frame.
states.phone_in_hand: A phone is held in either hand. Per frame.
states.phone_near_face: A held phone is within one face-width of the face. Per frame.
states.phone_visible: Any phone is visible in the frame (held, mounted or lying). Per frame.
states.face_visible: At least both eyes and the nose are visible. Per frame.
